text:
Tia (oncall): incident-bot paging: router-fallback-loop for dedicated pool 'eu-west-1-prod' — alerts show repeated fallback to smaller variant and 5xx spikes :warning:
incident-bot: Alert 4523: router.fallback.loop detected (5m). affected routes: /v1/generate (customers: 3), fallback_count: 312
Tia (oncall): I'm taking this, pinging @Raj W and @Cam S. Looks like fallback loop coinciding with autoscaler churn for dedicated pool.
Raj W: on it, grabbing metrics. initial thought: heartbeat/health signals from pool proxies flipped recently after the kernel bump?
Mikaela: I see a lot of router logs showing metric 'available_capacity=0' while GPUs are still up. possible signal inversion from capacity-proxy.
Cam S: past deploy of capacity-proxy v2.1 rolled 01:12 today to eu-west-1. Could be related.
Tia (oncall): customer impact: 3 paying customers saw latency -> timeouts, some requests 503. Need mitigation: stop fallbacks and force route to stable variant.
Raj W: recommend quick mitigation: set router fallback_policy=none for the affected routes, and pin model variant to 'redwood-2.1-opt' for those customers. Doing dry-run now.
Mikaela: copying runbook snippet, running command to disable fallback on router cluster:
```
# run on control plane
redwoodctl router update-policy --cluster eu-west-1-prod \
  --route /v1/generate --fallback none --reason "hotfix - stop loop"
```
Tia (oncall): applying now.
ops-runner: command accepted, rollout started, patch id p-7842.
Cam S: fallback disabled, traffic should stop being sent to smaller variants. monitoring traces.
Raj W: next, autoscaler: it appears dedicated pool autoscaler is interpreting proxy heartbeat as 'stale' and issuing scale-to-zero, then router detects low capacity and falls back to lower variant -> loop when autoscaler scales back up and proxies misreport.
Mikaela: pulling autoscaler timeline:
```
2026-03-15T01:10:12Z autoscaler: scale-down requested pool=dedicated-eu-1 target=1 -> 0
2026-03-15T01:10:18Z capacity-proxy: heartbeat liveness toggled -> stale
2026-03-15T01:10:22Z router: available_capacity=0 -> trigger fallback
2026-03-15T01:10:45Z autoscaler: scale-up requested pool=dedicated-eu-1 target=0 -> 2
```
Cam S: that 6-second window looks like race. We need to stop autoscaler from thrashing while we stabilize.
Tia (oncall): set autoscaler min-replicas to 1 for the pool and extend heartbeat timeouts to avoid immediate scale-down.
Raj W: executing:
```
redwoodctl autoscaler update --pool dedicated-eu-1 --min-replicas 1 --scale-down-unavailable-time 300s
```
ops-runner: autoscaler patch applied p-7843. min-replicas=1 now.
Mikaela: increasing capacity-proxy heartbeat grace period to 45s to avoid transient flaps. Pushing config to canary nodes.
Cam S: canary config applied to 2 nodes, watching. Router fallback events dropping. 5xx rate for affected routes down from 12% -> 1.6% in last 4m.
Tia (oncall): good. Customer-impact update: support team notified; affected requests retried by clients, no confirmed data loss, SLA blips for 3 customers.
Mikaela: still seeing leftover metrics in router: some cached states still report wrong variant. Will run cache flush for router cluster.
Raj W: flush command: `redwoodctl router flush-cache --cluster eu-west-1-prod --scope route:/v1/generate`
Cam S: cache flushed, metrics now consistent.
Tia (oncall): preparing incident summary and timeline. Notes: root cause appears to be capacity-proxy heartbeat flip after proxy upgrade -> autoscaler misinterprets as unavailable -> scale-down -> router fallback -> traffic blackhole loop. Fixes: disabled fallback, raised autoscaler min replicas, increased heartbeat grace, flushed router cache.
Mikaela: followups: revert capacity-proxy 2.1 or patch heartbeat semantics, add integration test to detect heartbeat inversion, and add router safety throttle so fallback doesn't trigger during rapid scale events.
ops-runner: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-5822 for rollback/patch and SRE-5823 for postmortem.
Tia (oncall): handing off to @Cam S for next shift overlap. If anything spikes back, page me. Otherwise I'll author the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
Cam S: acknowledged, will monitor next 2h and verify rollback plan with infra team.
incident-bot: Incident 2026-03-15-2012345678 created and linked to INFRA-5822, SRE-5823.
Tia (oncall): thanks all — good mitigation work. Closing active paging.
Cam S: closing thread, leaving notes in incident doc. :thumbsup:
